competitors.name: Conagra Brands
competitors.action: New CEO John Brase said Conagra is preparing portfolio-simplification moves, SKU reductions and possible brand divestitures after FY2026 net sales of $11.3B; he specifically cited underinvestment in on-trend snacks and frozen offerings.

trends.magnitude: 23% of U.S. households now using GLP-1 medications; projected to represent 35% of food and beverage units sold by 2030
trends.context: Progressive Grocer reported that GLP-1 adoption is already changing basket composition toward protein, fiber and healthy fats and away from high-carbohydrate and high-sugar products, with retail and CPG leaders organizing around assortment and innovation implications.

trends.topic: Grocer price-cut programs becoming a core traffic strategy
trends.magnitude: Multiple recent programs, including Giant Eagle averaging 10% cuts on 300 items and Walmart cutting prices on staples such as ground beef, produce and snacks
trends.context: Grocery Dive reported that retailers are making visible price investments, loyalty and promotions a top priority as shoppers remain pressured by gas prices and food inflation; premium frozen and artisan items need a clearer value/velocity case in this environment.
